item.title: zharlzzz
item.description:
One never knows what to expect when I enter the scene. I run a full gamut from friendly, to intimidating, and very stop in between. Many have said I am eccentric and idiosyncratic to the extreme. I kinda seen it. All I can say is that I possessed a raw-rare kind of charisma. 🫢
My tastes in general and hobbies are eclectic. I'm kinda all over the place. I kept an open mind and love to experience new things at least once and some days nothing at all. 🥴
I am nothing special. I don't hold the answers to any of lifes greatest mysteries. Other than the meaning of it at age 30s. I have however, managed to solve a few of my own questions over time and will always be willing to lend what others advices are. I guess it should add now that I'm however a solitary creature by nature and mostly often shun by the company of others unless they're invited in. But if I'm force to play with others. I'll do my best to make a memorable impression. 😶
My main purpose for being here was first friends and then to be among with like-minded individuals whom can understand and appreciate my longingness to create and sustain the rich sensuous qualities that are the tangible ambiance of embrace darkness. 😖
I'm sure you can already see my nature and tastes tend to be rather twisted though my words will. When at my best, be expertly crafted and unleash with eloquence. Such elegant mannerisms flatter my sensibilities. Though test me and you shall find that I'm a skilled nemesis, unfaze by my release of venomous verbs of ruthless candor (a cut delivered with a calm precision). 🤐
I creation of the Almighty Father. Do hereby pledge to honor the strictures of the sacred heritage and promise by my faith to be loyal unto my sovereignty. Maintaining my devotion against all persons without deception or forethought. 🙂
Furthermore, I vow to promote and uphold the principles of valor, honor, honesty, and humility. And to solemnly and faithfully follow the edicts of my faith. I take this pledge freely without coercion or expectation of reward. Sworn in the blessed memory to those who have given their lives to these noble cause. 🙏
Bendiciones para ustedes. 😇 https://zharlzzz.blogspot.com
